question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：比利时 vs 伊朗（90 分钟赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: Belgium vs IR Iran (90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 比利时 Elo 高出 122 分、纸面占优，但双核带伤与伊朗的韧性让这场更像六成把握而非碾压局。
one_liner_en: Belgium's 122-point Elo edge makes them clear favourites on paper, but star fitness doubts and Iran's resilience keep this a 60-40 type game rather than a blowout.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 122 分（比利时 1894/第15 vs 伊朗 1772/第29），中立场统计模型给比利时约 50% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: 122-point Elo gap (Belgium 1894/15th vs Iran 1772/29th); the neutral-venue statistical model gives Belgium about 50%.

key_reasons.cn: 伊朗将阿兹蒙整队除名，91 场 57 球的二号射手空缺，进攻端实质降级。
key_reasons.en: Iran omitted Azmoun entirely, leaving a 57-goals-in-91-caps void and a material attacking downgrade.

key_reasons.cn: 德布劳内（眼伤）与卢卡库（髋伤、全季仅 7 场）带伤入选，比利时进攻核心状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: De Bruyne (eye injury) and Lukaku (hip, only 7 club matches all season) were named while injured, leaving Belgium's attacking core's fitness in doubt.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 50.3/24.8/24.9, plus bounded evidence-based adjustment (net +1.5pp Belgium, -1.0pp Iran, -0.5pp draw), renormalized. No betting/prediction-market data used.
